Container.Name: dvdcompress
Container.Overview: Hardware-accelerated web application for authoring and burning standard-compliant DVD-Video (VIDEO_TS) and Blu-ray (BDMV) discs and ISO images with NVIDIA GPU acceleration (NVENC/NVDEC) and optical drive pass-through.
Container.Description: DVDCompress allows you to select video files from mapped storage, automatically calculates optimal bitrates to fit single-layer (4.7GB / 25GB) or dual-layer (8.5GB / 50GB) DVD+R or Blu-ray discs, authors standard-compliant VIDEO_TS and BDMV directory structures, and writes directly to connected optical drives or creates ISO images.

Config.Name: Media Directory
Config.Description: Path to your unencrypted video files (Movies, TV Shows, Home Videos)

Config.Name: Scratch Temp Directory
Config.Description: Fast scratch space for transcoding and authoring

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: GPU UUID or all for hardware transcoding

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: NVIDIA driver capabilities (all, compute, video, utility)
